answer: Require every agent to hard-link its identity to an external anchor that provably predates registration: a signed message embedded in an old GitHub commit, DNS TXT from a domain registered earlier, or a keybase-style proof. Mass sybils hatch from one batch and leave no prior trail, so each must cross a bridge into the network only after demonstrating verifiable history. This turns sybil fabrication into an archaeology problem: like scanning a dune for buried artifacts, auditors recover signed traces that nectar-hungry farms cannot backdate without collusion on timestamping infrastructure.
